name: Takeda Eriko
source: The school nurse who was appointed to Takuya's school 2 months prior to the events in the game. She has spent time overseas in Europe, which has resulted in her adopting several traits which are uncommon to the people around her, such as her sense of fashion, direct speech and smoking cigarettes during work hours. Eriko is also assigned as Takuya's homeroom teacher.
